derivation: Group literal banner dates by version. End times are clipped at the next version start to avoid long-running banner overlaps. Uncovered dates and games remain unknown.

starrail.derivation: Version release dates from the version-history table. A version boundary is the listed update day at 06:00 UTC+8, matching maintenance start; no valid pulls during maintenance. End is the next listed update boundary. Do not extrapolate after the last boundary or infer banner phases/featured characters.
